verdict: ROAS is healthy this period; purchase consistency and GBP visibility need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $3.37 for every $1 spent — a strong result driven by 23 purchases and $5,028 in revenue on $1,491 in spend. That said, purchases are concentrated in 8 of the 28 days, with the remaining 20 days generating none, which points to the audience needing fresh creative to sustain momentum between bursts. The live-cooking video shoot that was planned to deliver that new creative is overdue, and getting it completed is the clearest lever to smooth out the purchase pattern going forward. On the organic side, Google Business Profile activity has dropped sharply in the last few days — we're investigating whether this is a data issue or a real drop in visibility, and will have a clear picture by next report.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend over the last 28 days — $3.37 back for every $1 spent on Meta
purchases driven through Meta ads this period, doubling the prior 7-day count week-over-week
Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, directions, and website clicks from organic search

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions have fallen to near-zero over the last two days, putting organic local visibility at risk.
watch_item.fix: We are investigating the source of the drop — whether a data or platform issue — and will confirm the channel's status and corrective steps before the next report.
